response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT CASE WHEN s.riskeval IS NULL OR TRIM(s.riskeval) = '' THEN NULL ELSE s.riskeval END AS rk, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY rk), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark, AVG(g.rate - b.bench) AS avg_margin_above_benchmark FROM g, b WHERE g.rate > b.bench

assumptions.assumption: A group's rate is total gbsize divided by total spanmin (ratio of sums) for the scans in that group.
Scans with NULL gbsize, or NULL or zero spanmin, are excluded because no rate can be computed for them.
Scans whose site has a NULL or blank riskeval form a single 'no status' group. Scans with no matching site are excluded by the inner join.
If no group is above the benchmark, the query returns one row of NULLs.

alternatives.interpretation: A group's rate is the average of the per-scan gbsize/spanmin ratios, rather than the ratio of sums.
